description: This file defines a Service class 'SyncService' responsible for creating and binding to a SyncAdapter for account synchronization in an Android application.

classes.name: SyncService
classes.description: An Android Service that manages and provides access to a SyncAdapter for synchronizing account data.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the SyncAdapter instance when the service is created, ensuring thread-safe singleton instantiation.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Provides the IBinder interface for the SyncAdapter when the service is bound.
